newsitem.title: UK: Glynwed off as SocGen cuts to "hold".
newsitem.headline: Glynwed off as SocGen cuts to "hold".

text.p: Shares in British engineering groups IMI Plc and Glynwed International Plc dropped on Wednesday after brokerage SocGen downgraded Glynwed from "buy" to "hold" and put IMI's figures "under review".
By 1330 GMT Glynwed were down 8-1/2p at 250-1/2p while IMI lost ten pence to 358-1/2p.
"We have downgraded Glynwed on the back of tighter margins and it will be also hit be the strong sterling", SocGen-analyst Zafar Khan said.
He reduced the Glynwed's pre-tax profit forecast for the current financial year 1997 ending December 31 to 91 from 96 million stg. Khan also cut his estimates for 1998 from 105 to 100 million stg.
Earlier this week also broker BZW had downgraded Glynwed from "buy" to "hold", market sources said.
The investment view on IMI would remain a "buy" although SocGen reviewed the figures since the engineering group could be as affected by the pounds strength as Glynwed, Zafar said.
